nodes.label: Default Backend Layout Preview
nodes.notes: Small dark/near-black thumbnail image representing the 'default' TYPO3 backend layout. Single-column or minimal layout structure implied by the uniform dark appearance. Used as a visual preview icon in the TYPO3 backend page layout selector.

nodes.label: Default Page Layout
nodes.notes: TYPO3 backend layout named 'default'. Represented by a small preview thumbnail. Part of the sitepackage BackendLayouts configuration. Likely a single full-width content area layout.
